learning_outcomes.text: Learn the definition of differential equation
Learn the solution methods of differential equations
Learn the application of differential equations
Learn Laplace and inverse Laplace transformation and applications

syllabus_topics: Fundamental of differential equations and classification of equations. Geometrical meanings of differential equations
First order separable and homogeneous equations and their solution procedures
Linear differential equations, Bernouilli and Riccati differential equations
Some applications of first order differential equations
Theory of higher order of differential equations, Higher order homogenous differential equations with constant coefficients
Higher order nonhomogenous differential equations with constant coefficients, Method of undetermined coefficients
The method of variation of parameters
Inverse Laplace transformations and their properties
Applications of Laplace and inverse Laplace transformations
Applications of Laplace and inverse Laplace transformations
bibliography: Ogün Doğru, Diferensiyel Denklemlerin Temelleri (Çeviri Kitap), Nobel Yayıncılık, 2013
Adil Mısır, Teori Teknik ve Uygulamalı Diferensiyel Denklemler, Gazi Kitabevi, 2016
